headline: IMF Approves $1.08 Billion Financial Package for Ecuador
summary: The International Monetary Fund approved a new $1.08 billion financing framework for Ecuador, authorizing an immediate disbursement of $377 million alongside a second $703 million arrangement following economic progress reviews.
why: The IMF provides emergency loans and economic oversight to member nations facing balance-of-payments difficulties.

impacts.name: Ecuador
impacts.why: Ecuador secured a $1.08 billion financial support package from the IMF.
